# Buggies For Sale Australia

> Australia's premier online store for off-road buggies, 4x4 UTVs, remote-control and motorized golf carts, youth go-karts, and genuine performance parts with nationwide depot dispatch.

Buggies For Sale (ABN: 53 635 284 267) is an Australian-owned and operated commercial and recreational vehicle supplier based in Sydney, New South Wales, with freight operations reaching Brisbane, Melbourne, Adelaide, Perth, and regional station hubs.

Every machine undergoes a 42-point Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) by certified Australian mechanics before being crated for hydraulic tailgate freight delivery.

- Contact Phone: [0420 128 746](tel:+61420128746)
- WhatsApp Support: [Direct WhatsApp Desk](https://wa.me/61420128746)
- Sales Email: [sales@buggiesforsale.com.au](mailto:sales@buggiesforsale.com.au)
- Minimum Order: $500 AUD
- Free Delivery Threshold: $1,000 AUD (Major Australian Metro Zones)
- Payment Rails: Direct Australian Bank Transfer (EFT), PayID Instant Settlement, Cryptocurrency (5% Discount), Commercial Tax Invoice

## Product Categories

- [Off-Road & Recreational Buggies](https://buggiesforsale.com.au/shop/off-road/): Side-by-Sides (SSV), 4x4 UTVs, 200cc Dune Buggies, and 72V Silent Lithium Electric Off-Road Buggies.
- [Golf Buggies & Carts](https://buggiesforsale.com.au/shop/golf-buggies/): Remote control golf buggies with gyroscope tracking, motorized lithium caddies, manual push buggies, and ride-on estate carts.
- [Buggy Brand Hub](https://buggiesforsale.com.au/brands/): Authorized models and factory parts from Polaris, MGI Golf, Can-Am, Motocaddy, Club Car, Segway Powersports, and CFMOTO.
- [Parts & Accessories](https://buggiesforsale.com.au/shop/parts-accessories/): Drop-in lithium batteries (24V/48V), synthetic rope winches, all-terrain beadlock tyres, and maintenance tooling.
- [Clearance & Ex-Demo Deals](https://buggiesforsale.com.au/shop/clearance/): Showroom ex-display buggies and factory runouts with full Australian warranty.

## Commercial Services & Guides

- [Wholesale & Commercial Fleets](https://buggiesforsale.com.au/wholesale/): Volume pricing, leasing, and fleet supply for golf clubs, resorts, and mining operations.
